name: EHDSECGAnnotationSet
title: ECG annotation set model
description: Time-anchored annotations. One set = one author (algorithm or person) at one time, as in the HL7 aECG annotationSet, SCP-ECG section 18 and the DICOM Waveform Annotation SR.

Wave boundary, beat class, episode, artefact.
ms from recording start (>= 0), or absolute time. Within the recording (ecg-ann-5).

Absent = all leads.
Optional value.
Between 0 and 1 (ecg-ann-4).
Unique within the set (ecg-ann-3).
localId of an existing annotation of the same set: wave -> beat -> episode (ecg-ann-3).
Long recordings: DICOM Waveform Annotation SR, WFDB annotations, or a tabular format to be specified.
SHA-256 of bulkPayload.
Links to the aggregates computed from the set (AF burden, event counts), which are derived results of the examination.
